scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: first inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail, Pii-chan Talks, chapter 2, after paragraph 0.
Input images: the three Kasa Jizō inline paintings are style references only; do not copy their characters or composition. Chapter 1's third painting is a character reference for Hayato, Kotone and Pii-chan only; do not repeat its scene or composition. No cover exists for this series.
Scene/backdrop: Kotone's tidy bedroom in a contemporary Japanese apartment, with a low desk and a softly lit window; quiet simplified furnishings, no signs or readable numbers.
Subject: Pii-chan, one small blue budgie, is safely inside her simple birdcage on the desk. Kotone, twelve, has dark hair in a neat low ponytail, a muted teal short-sleeved top and a dark indigo skirt. Hayato, eight, is noticeably shorter, with short tousled dark hair, an ivory T-shirt and sage-green shorts. The siblings calmly settle beside the cage and look over a care note from Mrs Nomura; show only the blank back of the paper, with no visible writing.
Character continuity: match the siblings' faces, relative ages, hair and summer clothes to the chapter 1 character reference. Pii-chan is the single blue budgie established in chapter 1.
Style/medium: simple painted children's picture-book art in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet background, much simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed 12:7 landscape; the cage and siblings form one clear, calm group, with the desk and bedroom kept simple.
Lighting/mood: soft morning light, attentive and reassuring.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, sage, natural wood ochre, restrained indigo and a clean blue accent for the bird.
Constraints: depict the cage being settled on Kotone's desk and the care-note moment from paragraph 0. Exactly one blue budgie, inside the closed cage. Keep the note blank and turned away.
Avoid: readable text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, borders, watermarks, extra people or animals, an open cage, bird outside the cage, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, Western-coded bedroom details.
scenes.paragraphMeaning: The siblings put Pii-chan's cage on Kotone's desk and receive the care instructions.
